title: A first look at the editor
goal: Add a text box, show the timeline, and find the list of keyboard keys.

startState.note: The smallest example course, first slide

intro: This short video tours three things you use every day in OpenStage Author.

steps.narration: Choose Text. A new text box appears on the slide.
steps.expect: A text box is added to the slide

steps.narration: Choose Timeline. It shows when each thing on the slide appears and goes.
Choose Keyboard keys to see every shortcut the editor has, in one list.
steps.expect: The keyboard keys list is open

steps.narration: Press Escape to close the list.
